Surah headingp. 522

Sura al-Qasas

‌ ‌سُورَةُ الْقَصَصِ

Report 01p. 522Q 28:4

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "and made its people into sects" [al-Qasas 4] he said: "meaning He divided them."

أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، ثنا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {وَجَعَلَ أَهْلَهَا شِيَعًا} [القصص: 4] ، قَالَ: «يَعْنِي فَرَّقَ بَيْنَهُمْ»

Report 02p. 522Q 28:6Q 28:7Q 28:11

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Abu Jafar al-Razi related to us, from al-Rabi ibn Anas, from Abu al-Aliya al-Riyahi, on His words: "and to show Pharaoh and Haman and their soldiers through them that which they feared" [al-Qasas 6] he said: "Pharaoh ruled them for four hundred years. The soothsayers said to him: 'This year a boy will be born in Egypt who will ruin your kingdom, and your destruction will be at his hands.' So Pharaoh sent midwives among the women of Egypt to watch, and whenever a woman bore a boy, he was brought to Pharaoh and he killed him, while he spared the girls. When Moses was born, God inspired his mother: 'Nurse him, and when you fear for him, cast him into the river' [al-Qasas 7], which is the sea. She was told: 'Make a chest and put him in it, then throw it into the sea,' and she did that. Pharaoh had a company of travelers who dove into the sea. When they saw the chest in the sea, they said: 'This is a gift that came from the sky for our lord,' meaning Pharaoh. They took the chest and went with it to Pharaoh. Pharaoh looked, and it was a boy. Pharaoh said: 'I see him as one of the enemies,' that is, of the newborns of Egypt, and he wanted to kill him. Pharaoh's wife said: 'A comfort of the eye for me and for you; do not kill him; perhaps he will benefit us or we may adopt him as a son.' He said: Pharaoh had only daughters born to him, so he left him. The mother of Moses said 'to his sister: Follow him' [al-Qasas 11], meaning follow his trace, and she followed the trace until she saw him with Pharaoh; 'so she watched him from a distance' [al-Qasas 11], meaning from the side, fearful and cautious. Wet nurses were called for him, but he accepted the breast of none of them. Moses' sister went and told [...]" [The Arabic text of this page breaks off here, mid-sentence, in the source edition.]

أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، ثنا أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ الرَّازِيُّ، عَنِ الرَّبِيعِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْعَالِيَةِ الرِّيَاحِيِّ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {وَنُرِيَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَهَامَانَ وَجُنُودَهُمَا مِنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوا يَحْذَرُونَ} [القصص: 6] قَالَ: " إِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ مَلَكَهُمْ أَرْبَعَمِائَةِ سَنَةٍ، فَقَالَتْ لَهُ الْكَهَنَةُ: إِنَّهُ يُولَدُ الْعَامَ فِي مِصْرَ غُلَامٌ يُفْسِدُ عَلَيْكَ مُلْكَكَ، وَيَكُونُ هَلَاكُكَ عَلَى يَدَيْهِ، فَبَعَثَ فِرْعَوْنُ فِي مِصْرَ نِسَاءً قَوَابِلَ يَنْظُرُونَ، فَإِذَا وَلَدَتِ امْرَأَةٌ غُلَامًا أُتِيَ بِهِ فِرْعَوْنُ فَقَتَلَهُ، فَكَانَ يَسْتَحْيِي الْجَوَارِيَ، فَلَمَّا وُلِدَ مُوسَى أَوْحَى اللَّهُ إِلَى أُمِّهِ {أَنْ أَرْضِعِيهِ فَإِذَا خِفْتِ عَلَيْهِ فَأَلْقِيهِ فِي الْيَمِّ} [القصص: 7] ، وَهُوَ الْبَحْرُ، فَقِيلَ لَهَا: اتَّخِذِي تَابُوتًا وَاجْعَلِيهِ فِيهِ، ثُمَّ اقْذِفِيهِ فِي الْبَحْرِ، فَفَعَلَتْ ذَلِكَ، وَكَانَ لِفِرْعَوْنَ قَوْمٌ سَيَّارَةٌ يَغُوصُونَ فِي الْبَحْرِ، فَلَمَّا رَأَوُا التَّابُوتَ فِي الْبَحْرِ، قَالُوا: هَذِهِ هَدِيَّةٌ جَاءَتْ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ لِرَبِّنَا، يَعْنُونَ فِرْعَوْنَ، فَأَخَذُوا التَّابُوتَ فَانْطَلَقُوا بِهِ إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ، فَنَظَرَ فِرْعَوْنُ فَإِذَا هُوَ غُلَامٌ، فَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ: إِنِّي أَرَاهُ مِنَ الْأَعْدَاءِ، أَيْ مِنْ مَوْلُودِي مِصْرَ، فَأَرَادَ قَتْلَهُ، فَقَالَتِ امْرَأَةُ فِرْعَوْنَ: {قُرَّةُ عَيْنٍ لِي وَلَكَ لَا تَقْتُلُوهُ عَسَى أَنْ يَنْفَعَنَا أَوْ نَتَّخِذَهُ وَلَدًا} قَالَ: وَكَانَ فِرْعَوْنُ لَا يُولَدُ لَهُ إِلَّا الْبَنَاتُ، فَتَرَكَهُ، فَقَالَتْ أُمُّ مُوسَى: {لِأُخْتِهِ قُصِّيهِ} [القصص: 11] ، يَعْنِي: قُصِّي الْأَثَرَ، فَقَصَّتِ الْأَثَرَ حَتَّى رَأَتْهُ عِنْدَ فِرْعَوْنَ {فَبَصُرَتْ بِهِ عَنْ جُنُبٍ} [القصص: 11] ، يَعْنِي: مُجَانَبَةً تَخَافُ وَتَتَّقِي، فَدُعِيَ لَهُ الْمَرَاضِعُ، فَلَمْ يَقْبَلْ ثَدْيَ امْرَأَةٍ مِنْهُنَّ، فَذَهَبَتْ أُخْتُ مُوسَى فَأَخْبَرَتْ

Report 03p. 523Q 28:12

[...] her mother. She said: "Go and say to them: 'Shall I direct you to a household who will be responsible for him for you, and they are to him sincere counselors?' [al-Qasas 12]" So Moses' sister went and said that to them, and they said to her: "Yes." Moses accepted her breast, and she stayed with them nursing him, while they did not know she was his mother, until she completed the nursing; then she went and left him with them. One day, while Moses was with Pharaoh, he slapped Pharaoh. Pharaoh said: "I told you he is one of the enemies," and wanted to kill him. Pharaoh's wife said: "He is a child who does not understand. Test him if you wish: put gold and a live coal in a basin and see which he grabs." Pharaoh did so. Moses wanted to take the gold, but the angel who had been assigned to him struck his hand and turned it to the coal, so Moses took hold of it and put it in his mouth. Pharaoh's wife said: "Did I not tell you that he does not understand?" He said: The faith of Pharaoh's wife came through the wife of Pharaoh's treasurer, and the faith of Pharaoh's treasurer came from the legacy of Joseph. The treasurer's wife was combing Pharaoh's daughter's hair one day when the comb fell from her, and she said: "Ruin to whoever disbelieves in God." Pharaoh's daughter said to her: "Do you have a lord other than my father?" She said: "My Lord and your father's Lord, and the Lord of everything is God." Pharaoh's daughter slapped her and struck her and told her father. Pharaoh sent for her and said to her: "Do you worship a lord other than me?" She said: "Yes, my Lord and your Lord, and the Lord of everything is God, and Him I worship." Pharaoh called her a liar and had stakes driven for her; he bound her hands and feet and sent snakes upon her. She remained so, and he came to her one day and said to her: "Will you not stop?" She said to him: "My Lord and your Lord and the Lord of everything

أُمَّهَا: فَقَالَتِ: اذْهَبِي، فَقُولِي لَهُمْ: {هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَى أَهْلِ بَيْتٍ يَكْفُلُونَهُ لَكُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُ نَاصِحُونَ} [القصص: 12] فَانْطَلَقَتْ أُخْتُ مُوسَى، فَقَالَتْ لَهُمْ ذَلِكَ، فَقَالُوا لَهَا: نَعَمْ، فَقَبِلَ مُوسَى ثَدْيَهَا، فَلَمْ تَزَلْ عِنْدَهُمْ تُرْضِعُهُ وَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّهَا أُمُّهُ حَتَّى أَتَمَّتِ الرَّضَاعَةَ، ثُمَّ ذَهَبَتْ فَتَرَكَتْهُ عِنْدَهُمْ، فَبَيْنَمَا مُوسَى ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ عِنْدَ فِرْعَوْنَ، إِذْ لَطَمَ فِرْعَوْنَ، فَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ: قَدْ قُلْتُ لَكُمْ: إِنَّهُ مِنَ الْأَعْدَاءِ، وَأَرَادَ قَتْلَهُ، فَقَالَتِ امْرَأَةُ فِرْعَوْنَ: إِنَّهُ صَبِيٌّ لَا يَعْقِلُ، فَجَرِّبْهُ إِنْ شِئْتَ، اجْعَلْ فِي الطَّسْتِ ذَهَبًا وَجَمْرًا، فَانْظُرْ عَلَى أَيُّهُمَا يَقْبِضُ، فَفَعَلَ فِرْعَوْنُ ذَلِكَ، فَأَرَادَ مُوسَى أَنْ يَقْبِضَ الذَّهَبَ، فَضَرَبَ الْمَلَكُ الَّذِي كَانَ وُكِّلَ بِهِ يَدَهُ، فَصَرَفَهَا إِلَى الْجَمْرَةِ فَقَبَضَ عَلَيْهَا مُوسَى فَأَلْقَاهَا فِي فِيهِ، فَقَالَتِ امْرَأَةُ فِرْعَوْنَ: أَلَمْ أَقُلْ لَكَ: إِنَّهُ لَا يَعْقِلُ، قَالَ: وَكَانَ إِيمَانُ امْرَأَةِ فِرْعَوْنَ مِنْ قِبَلِ امْرَأَةِ خَازِنِ فِرْعَوْنَ، وَكَانَ إِيمَانُ خَازِنِ فِرْعَوْنَ مِنْ أَثَرِ يُوسُفَ، وَأَنَّ امْرَأَةَ خَازِنِ فِرْعَوْنَ مَشَطَتِ ابْنَةَ فِرْعَوْنَ يَوْمًا، فَوَقَعَ مِنْهَا الْمُشْطُ، فَقَالَتْ: تَعِسَ مَنْ كَفَرَ بِاللَّهِ، فَقَالَتْ لَهَا بِنْتُ فِرْعَوْنَ: أَلَكِ رَبٌّ غَيْرُ أَبِي، فَقَالَتْ: رَبِّي وَرَبُّ أَبِيكِ، وَرَبُّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ اللَّهُ فَلَطَمَتْهَا ابْنَةُ فِرْعَوْنَ، وَضَرَبَتْهَا، وَأَخْبَرَتْ أَبَاهَا، فَأَرْسَلَ فِرْعَوْنُ، فَقَالَ لَهَا: أَتَعْبُدِينَ رَبًّا غَيْرِي، فَقَالَتْ: نَعَمْ، رَبِّي وَرَبُّكَ، وَرَبُّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ اللَّهُ، وَإِيَّاهُ أَعْبُدُ فَكَذَّبَهَا فِرْعَوْنُ وَأَوْتَدَ لَهَا أَوْتَادًا، فَشَدَّ يَدَيْهَا وَرِجْلَيْهَا وَأَرْسَلَ عَلَيْهَا الْحَيَّاتِ، وَكَانَتْ كَذَلِكَ فَأَتَى عَلَيْهَا يَوْمًا، فَقَالَ لَهَا: أَمَا أَنْتِ مُنْتَهِيَةٌ؟ فَقَالَتْ لَهُ: رَبِّي وَرَبُّكَ وَرَبُّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ

Report 04p. 524Q 66:11

is God." He said to her: "Then I will slaughter your son in your mouth unless you recant." She said to him: "Do what you will." So he slaughtered her son in her mouth, and her son's spirit gave her good news and said to her: "Be patient, mother, for you have such-and-such reward with God." She was patient. Then Pharaoh came to her another day and said the same to her, and she said the same to him, and he slaughtered her youngest son in her mouth. His spirit also gave her good news and said to her: "Be patient, mother, for you have such-and-such reward with God." All of that was in sight of Pharaoh's wife, and she heard the speech of the spirit of the elder son, then the younger. So Pharaoh's wife believed. The spirit of the treasurer's wife was taken, and the covering was removed so that Pharaoh's wife saw her reward, her station, and her honor in Paradise, and her faith, certainty, and affirmation increased. Pharaoh learned of her faith and went out to the nobles and said to them: "What do you know of Asiya daughter of Muzahim?" They praised her. He said to them: "She worships a lord other than me." They said to him: "Kill her." So he had stakes driven for her and bound her hands and feet. Asiya called upon her Lord and said: "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people" [al-Tahrim 11]. The covering was removed for her and she looked at her house in Paradise; it happened that Pharaoh was present, and she laughed when she saw her house in Paradise. Pharaoh said: "Do you not marvel at her madness? We are torturing her and she is laughing." Then her spirit was taken. The believer of the family of Pharaoh used to devote himself to worship on a mountain; a man saw him, went to Pharaoh, and told him. Pharaoh summoned him and said to him: "What is this that has reached me about you?" The believer said to him: "O nobles, who is your Lord?" They said: "Pharaoh." He said: "Then I bear witness to you that my Lord and your Lord is One." Pharaoh believed the man who had come to him and told him of the believer's faith, and killed him.

اللَّهُ، فَقَالَ لَهَا: فَإِنِّي ذَابِحٌ ابْنَكِ فِي فِيكِ إِنْ لَمْ تَرْجِعِي، فَقَالَتْ لَهُ: اقْضِ مَا أَنْتَ قَاضٍ، فَذَبَحَ ابْنَهَا فِي فِيهَا، وَإِنَّ رُوحَ ابْنِهَا بَشَّرَهَا، فَقَالَ لَهَا: اصْبِرِي يَا أُمَّهُ فَإِنَّ لَكِ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ مِنَ الثَّوَابِ كَذَا وَكَذَا، فَصَبَرْتَ، ثُمَّ أَتَى عَلَيْهَا فِرْعَوْنُ يَوْمًا آخَرَ، فَقَالَ لَهَا مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ، فَقَالَتْ لَهُ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ فَذَبَحَ ابْنَهَا الْأَصْغَرَ فِي فِيهَا، فَبَشَّرَهَا رُوحُهُ أَيْضًا، وَقَالَ لَهَا: اصْبِرِي يَا أُمَّهُ، فَإِنَّ لَكِ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ مِنَ الثَّوَابِ كَذَا وَكَذَا، وَذَلِكَ كُلُّهُ بِعَيْنِ امْرَأَةِ فِرْعَوْنَ وَسَمِعَتْ كَلَامَ رُوحِ ابْنِهَا الْأَكْبَرِ، ثُمَّ الْأَصْغَرِ، فَآمَنَتِ امْرَأَةُ فِرْعَوْنَ، وَقُبِضَ رُوحُ امْرَأَةِ خَازِنِ فِرْعَوْنَ، وَكُشِفَ الْغِطَاءُ عَنْ ثَوَابِهَا وَمَنْزِلَتِهَا وَكَرَامَتِهَا فِي الْجَنَّةِ لِامْرَأَةِ فِرْعَوْنَ حَتَّى رَأَتْهُ فَازْدَادَتْ إِيمَانًا وَيَقِينًا وَتَصْدِيقًا، وَاطَّلَعَ فِرْعَوْنُ عَلَى إِيمَانِهَا، فَخَرَجَ إِلَى الْمَلَأِ، فَقَالَ لَهُمْ: مَا تَعْلَمُونَ مِنْ آسِيَةَ بِنْتِ مُزَاحِمٍ؟ فَأَثْنَوْا عَلَيْهَا، فَقَالَ لَهُمْ: وَإِنَّهَا تَعْبُدُ رَبًّا غَيْرِي، فَقَالُوا لَهُ: اقْتُلْهَا، فَأَوْتَدَ لَهَا أَوْتَادًا، وَشَدَّ يَدَيْهَا وَرِجْلَيْهَا فَدَعَتْ آسِيَةُ رَبَّهَا فَقَالَتْ: {رَبِّ ابْنِ لِي عِنْدَكَ بَيْتًا فِي الْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِي مِنْ فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِ وَنَجِّنِي مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ} [التحريم: 11] فَكَشَفَ لَهَا الْغِطَاءَ فَنَظَرَتْ إِلَى بَيْتِهَا فِي الْجَنَّةِ وَوَافَقَ ذَلِكَ أَنْ حَضَرَهَا فِرْعَوْنُ وَضَحِكَتْ حِينَ رَأَتْ بَيْتَهَا فِي الْجَنَّةِ، فَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ: أَلَا تَعْجَبُونَ مِنْ جُنُونِهَا، إِنَّا نُعَذِّبُهَا وَهِيَ تَضْحَكُ فَقُبِضَ رُوحُهَا، وَإِنَّ مُؤْمِنَ آلِ فِرْعَوْنَ كَانَ يَتَعَبَّدُ فِي جَبَلٍ، فَرَآهُ رَجُلٌ فَأَتَى فِرْعَوْنَ فَأَخْبَرَهُ، فَدَعَاهُ فِرْعَوْنُ، فَقَالَ لَهُ: مَا هَذَا الَّذِي بَلَغَنِي عَنْكَ؟ قَالَ لَهُ الْمُؤْمِنُ: يَا أَيُّهَا الْمَلَأُ مَنْ رَبُّكُمْ؟ فَقَالُوا: فِرْعَوْنُ، قَالَ: فَإِنِّي أُشْهِدُكُمْ أَنَّ رَبِّيَ وَرَبَّكُمْ وَاحِدٌ، فَكَذَّبَ فِرْعَوْنُ الرَّجُلَ الَّذِي أَتَاهُ فَأَخْبَرَهُ عَنْهُ بِإِيمَانِهِ فَقَتَلَهُ "

Report 05p. 525Q 28:11

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "Follow him" [al-Qasas 11] He says: "follow his trace, what is done with him."

أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {قُصِّيهِ} [القصص: 11] ، يَقُولُ: «اتْبَعِي أَثَرَهُ مَا يُصْنَعُ بِهِ»

Report 06p. 525Q 28:11

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "so she watched him from a distance" [al-Qasas 11] he said: "from afar."

أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {فَبَصُرَتْ بِهِ عَنْ جُنُبٍ} [القصص: 11] قَالَ: «عَنْ بَعِيدٍ»

Report 07p. 525Q 28:11

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "while they did not perceive" [al-Qasas 11] he said: "the family of Pharaoh did not perceive that she was his sister."

أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ} [القصص: 11] قَالَ: " لَا يَشْعُرُ آلُ فِرْعَوْنَ أَنَّهَا أُخْتُهُ

Report 08p. 525Q 28:12

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "And We had forbidden to him wet nurses before" [al-Qasas 12] he said: "he accepted the breast of no woman until he returned to his mother."

أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، ثنا آدَمُ، ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {وَحَرَّمْنَا عَلَيْهِ الْمَرَاضِعَ مِنْ قَبْلُ} [القصص: 12] قَالَ: «لَمْ يَقْبَلْ ثَدْيَ امْرَأَةٍ حَتَّى رَجَعَ إِلَى أُمِّهِ»

Report 09p. 525Q 28:14

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid: "And when he reached maturity" [al-Qasas 14] meaning: "thirty-three years," "and was established" [al-Qasas 14] meaning: "forty years."

أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، ثنا آدَمُ، ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ: {وَلَمَّا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ} [القصص: 14] ، يَعْنِي: «ثَلَاثًا وَثَلَاثِينَ سَنَةً» ، {وَاسْتَوَى} [القصص: 14] ، يَعْنِي: «أَرْبَعِينَ سَنَةً»

Report 10p. 525Q 12:22

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "We gave him judgment and knowledge" [Yusuf 22] he said: "meaning understanding, intellect, and knowledge before prophethood."

أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {آتَيْنَاهُ حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا} [يوسف: 22] قَالَ: «يَعْنِي الْفِقْهَ وَالْعَقْلَ وَالْعِلْمَ قَبْلَ النُّبُوَّةِ»

Report 11p. 525Q 28:15

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid: "and the one from his faction called for help" [al-Qasas 15] he said: "meaning from his people, the Children of Israel." He said: "Pharaoh was from Persia, from Istakhr."

أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ: {فَاسْتَغَاثَهُ الَّذِي مِنْ شِيعَتِهِ} [القصص: 15] قَالَ: «يَعْنِي مِنْ قَوْمِهِ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ» قَالَ: «وَكَانَ فِرْعَوْنُ مِنْ فَارِسَ مِنْ إِصْطَخْرَ»

Report 12p. 525Q 28:15

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "so Moses struck him" [al-Qasas 15] he said: "meaning with his closed fist."

أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {فَوَكَزَهُ مُوسَى} [القصص: 15] قَالَ: «يَعْنِي بِجَمْعِ كَفِّهِ»

Report 13p. 526Q 28:22

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "Perhaps my Lord will guide me to the right way" [al-Qasas 22] he said: "meaning the road to Midian."

أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {عَسَى رَبِّي أَنْ يَهْدِيَنِي سَوَاءَ السَّبِيلِ} [القصص: 22] قَالَ: «يَعْنِي الطَّرِيقَ إِلَى مَدْيَنَ»

Report 14p. 526Q 28:23Q 28:24Q 28:25Q 28:26

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Israil related to us, from Abu Ishaq al-Hamdani, from Amr ibn Maymun al-Awdi, from Umar ibn al-Khattab, on His words: "And when he came to the water of Midian" [al-Qasas 23] he said: "When Moses came to the water of Midian, 'he found there a crowd of people watering' [al-Qasas 23]. When they finished, they put the rock back over the well, which only ten men could lift off the well. And there were two women holding back [their flock]. He said to them: 'What is your circumstance?' They said: 'We cannot water until the shepherds depart, and our father is an old man' [al-Qasas 23]. Moses lifted the stone by himself and drew only one bucket until the sheep were watered. Then he went to the shade and said: 'My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You send down to me, in need' [al-Qasas 24]. The two women returned to their father and told him what had happened. 'Then one of them came to him walking with shyness' [al-Qasas 25], meaning with her garment over her face, not a woman who goes out and about nor one who slips in and out. She said to him: 'My father invites you to reward you for having watered for us' [al-Qasas 25]. Moses said to her: 'Walk behind me and describe the road to me, for I fear the wind will touch your clothes and show me your body.' When she reached her father, she said to him: 'O my father, hire him; the best one you can hire is the strong, the trustworthy' [al-Qasas 26]. Her father said to her: 'What do you know of his strength and trustworthiness?' She said: 'As for his strength, he lifted the stone by himself, and none but ten can ⦗p. 527⦘ lift it; as for his trustworthiness, it is his saying: Walk behind me and describe the road to me, lest the wind describe your body to me.'"

أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، ثنا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ الْهَمَذَانِيِّ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ الْأَوْدِيِّ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {وَلَمَّا وَرَدَ مَاءَ مَدْيَنَ} [القصص: 23] قَالَ: " إِنَّ مُوسَى لَمَّا وَرَدَ مَاءَ مَدْيَنَ {وَجَدَ عَلَيْهِ أُمَّةً مِنَ النَّاسِ يَسْقُونَ} [القصص: 23] ، فَلَمَّا فَرَغُوا أَعَادُوا الصَّخْرَةَ عَلَى الْبِئْرِ، وَكَانَ لَا يُطِيقُ رَفْعَهَا عَنِ الْبِئْرِ إِلَّا عَشَرَةُ رِجَالٍ، وَإِذَا هُوَ بِامْرَأَتَيْنِ تَذُودَانِ، فَقَالَ لَهُمَا: مَا خَطْبُكَمَا؟ فَقَالَتَا: لَا نَقْدِرُ عَلَى أَنْ {نَسْقِيَ حَتَّى يُصْدِرَ الرِّعَاءُ وَأَبُونَا شَيْخٌ كَبِيرٌ} [القصص: 23] ، فَرَفَعَ مُوسَى الْحَجَرَ وَحْدَهُ، فَلَمْ يَسْتَقِ إِلَّا دَلْوًا وَاحِدًا حَتَّى رُوِيَتِ الْغَنَمُ، ثُمَّ انْطَلَقَ إِلَى الظِّلِّ {فَقَالَ: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنْزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ} [القصص: 24] فَرَجَعَتِ الْمَرْأَتَانِ إِلَى أَبِيهِمَا فَحَدَّثَتَاهُ بِمَا كَانَ {فَجَاءَتْهُ إِحْدَاهُمَا تَمْشِي عَلَى اسْتِحْيَاءٍ} [القصص: 25] ، يَعْنِي: وَاضِعَةً ثَوْبَهَا عَلَى وَجْهِهَا لَيْسَتْ بِخَرَّاجَةٍ وَلَا وَلَّاجَةٍ، فَقَالَتْ لَهُ: {إِنَّ أَبِي يَدْعُوكَ لِيَجْزِيَكَ أَجْرَ مَا سَقَيْتَ لَنَا} [القصص: 25] فَقَالَ لَهَا مُوسَى: امْشِي خَلْفِي، وَصِفِي لِيَ الطَّرِيقَ، فَإِنِّي أَخَافُ أَنْ تُصِيبَ الرِّيحُ ثِيَابَكِ، فَتَصِفَ لِي جَسَدَكِ، فَلَمَّا انْتَهَتْ إِلَى أَبِيهَا، قَالَتْ لَهُ: {يَا أَبَتِ اسْتَأْجِرْهُ إِنَّ خَيْرَ مَنِ اسْتَأْجَرْتَ الْقَوِيُّ الْأَمِينُ} [القصص: 26] فَقَالَ لَهَا أَبُوهَا: وَمَا عِلْمُكِ بِقُوَّتِهِ وَأَمَانَتِهِ؟، فَقَالَتْ: أَمَّا قُوَّتُهُ فَإِنَّهُ رَفَعَ الْحَجَرَ وَحْدَهُ، وَلَا يُطِيقُ ⦗ص: 527⦘ رَفْعُهُ إِلَّا عَشَرَةٌ، وَأَمَّا أَمَانَتُهُ، فَقَوْلُهُ: امْشِي خَلْفِي، وَصِفِي لِيَ الطَّرِيقَ، لَا تَصِفُ لِيَ الرِّيحُ جَسَدَكِ "

Report 15p. 527Q 28:24

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid: "Indeed I am, for whatever good You send down to me, in need" [al-Qasas 24] he said: "some food."

أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، ثنا آدَمُ، ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ: {إِنِّي لِمَا أَنْزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ} [القصص: 24] قَالَ: «شَيْءٌ مِنْ طَعَامٍ»

Report 16p. 527

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Aban al-Attar related to us, from Abu Imran al-Jawni, who said: "Gabriel said to the Prophet ﷺ: 'If they ask you which of the two terms Moses fulfilled, say: the better and more generous of them; and if they ask you which of the two girls Moses married, say: the younger, and her name was Sipporah.'"

أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا أَبَانُ الْعَطَّارُ، عَنْ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيِّ، قَالَ: " قَالَ جِبْرِيلُ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: إِنْ سَأَلُوكَ أَيُّ الْأَجَلَيْنِ قَضَى مُوسَى؟ فَقُلْ: أَفْضَلَهُمَا وَأَكْرَمَهُمَا، وَإِنْ سَأَلُوكَ أَيُّ الْجَارِيَتَيْنِ تَزَوَّجَ مُوسَى؟ فَقُلْ: أَصْغَرَهُمَا وَكَانَ اسْمُهَا صفوريا

Report 17p. 527

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Hibban related to us, from Sad ibn Turayf, from Miqsam Abu Abd al-Rahman, who said: I said to al-Hasan ibn Ali: "Which of the two terms did Moses fulfill?" He said: "The longer of them." I said: "And what was his wife's name?" He said: "Balaqis [sic]."

أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، ثنا حَبَّانُ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ طَرِيفٍ، عَنْ مِقْسَمٍ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ: أَيُّ الْأَجَلَيْنِ قَضَى مُوسَى؟ قَالَ: «أَكْثَرَهُمَا» ، قُلْتُ: فَمَا كَانَ اسْمُ امْرَأَتِهِ، قَالَ: «بَلَاقِيسُ»

Report 18p. 527Q 28:26

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, who said: As for His words "the strong" [al-Qasas 26]: "he moved the stone from the well for them and watered for them; as for his trustworthiness: he lowered his gaze from them until he had watered for them and they departed."

أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ: أَمَّا قَوْلُهُ {الْقَوِيُّ} [القصص: 26] «فَإِنَّهُ نَحَّى لَهُمَا الْحَجَرَ عَنِ الْبِئْرِ فَسَقَى لَهُمَا، وَأَمَّا أَمَانَتُهُ فَغَضَّ طَرْفَهُ عَنْهُمَا حَتَّى سَقَى لَهُمَا فَصَدَرَتَا»

Report 19p. 527Q 28:28

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn al-Mubarak, from Ibn Jurayj, on His words: "then there is no aggression against me, and God, over what we say, is Witness" [al-Qasas 28] he said: "meaning Witness."

أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، ثنا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {فَلَا عُدْوَانَ عَلَيَّ وَاللَّهُ عَلَى مَا نَقُولُ وَكِيلٌ} [القصص: 28] قَالَ: «يَعْنِي شَهِيدٌ»

Report 20p. 528

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Hammad ibn Salama related to us, saying: Abu Jamra related to us, from Ibn Abbas, who said: "The name of Moses' father-in-law was Yathribi."

أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، نا أَبُو جَمْرةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ: «كَانَ اسْمُ خَتَنِ مُوسَى يثربي»

Report 21p. 528

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, who said: "Moses completed ten years, and then remained ten more years after that."

أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ: قَالَ «قَضَى مُوسَى عَشْرَ سِنِينَ، ثُمَّ مَكَثَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ عَشْرَ سِنِينَ أُخْرَى»

Report 22p. 528Q 28:29

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "or a burning stick from the fire" [al-Qasas 29] he said: "The jadhwa is the stump of a tree."

أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {أَوْ جَذْوَةٍ مِنَ النَّارِ} [القصص: 29] قَالَ: " الْجَذْوَةُ: أَصْلُ شَجَرَةٍ "

Report 23p. 528

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "he was called from the right side of the valley," meaning: "by the mountain, on the right of Moses."

أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {نُودِيَ مِنْ شَاطِئِ الْوَادِ الْأَيْمَنِ} ، يَعْنِي: «عِنْدَ الطُّورِ، عَنْ يَمِينِ مُوسَى»

Report 24p. 528Q 28:31

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "and did not return" [al-Qasas 31] he said: "and did not go back."

أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ فِي قَوْلِهِ: {وَلَمْ يُعَقِّبْ} [القصص: 31] قَالَ: «وَلَمْ يَرْجِعْ»

Report 25p. 528Q 28:32

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "from fear [rahb]" [al-Qasas 32] meaning: "from dread."

أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {مِنَ الرَّهْبِ} [القصص: 32] ، يَعْنِي: «مِنَ الْفَرَقِ»

Report 26p. 529Q 28:32

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "these are two proofs from your Lord" [al-Qasas 32] he said: "the staff and the hand."

أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {بُرْهَانَانِ مِنْ رَبِّكِ} [القصص: 32] قَالَ: «الْعَصَا وَالْيَدُ»

Report 27p. 529Q 28:34

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid: "as a support [rid']" [al-Qasas 34] he said: "a helper."

أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ: {رِدْءًا} [القصص: 34] قَالَ: «عَوْنًا»

Report 28p. 529Q 28:35

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid: "and We will give you both authority" [al-Qasas 35] he said: "He says: We will give you both an argument through Our signs so that they cannot reach you; 'you and those who follow you will be the predominant' [al-Qasas 35]."

أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ: {وَنَجْعَلُ لَكُمَا سُلْطَانًا} [القصص: 35] قَالَ: " يَقُولُ: نَجْعَلُ لَكُمَا حُجَّةً بِآيَاتِنَا فَلَا يَصِلُونَ إِلَيْكُمَا "، {أَنْتُمَا وَمَنِ اتَّبَعَكُمَا الْغَالِبُونَ} [القصص: 35]

Report 29p. 529Q 28:38

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn al-Mubarak, from Ibn Jurayj, on His words: "Then ignite for me, O Haman, [a fire] upon the clay" [al-Qasas 38] he said: "meaning upon mud-brick; He says: bake it, meaning into baked brick."

أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجِ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {فَأَوْقِدْ لِي يَا هَامَانُ عَلَى الطِّينِ} [القصص: 38] قَالَ: " يَعْنِي عَلَى الْمَدَرِ يَقُولُ: اطْبُخْهُ، يَعْنِي: الْآجُرَّ "

Report 30p. 529Q 28:48

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "Why was he not given like that which was given to Moses?" [al-Qasas 48] he said: "The Jews told Quraysh to ask Muhammad for the like of what Moses was given. So God said to Muhammad: say to Quraysh, let them say to the Jews, 'Did they not disbelieve in what Moses was given before?' [al-Qasas 48]."

أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، ثنا آدَمُ، ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {لَوْلَا أُوتِيَ مِثْلَ مَا أُوتِيَ مُوسَى} [القصص: 48] قَالَ: " يَهُوَدُ تَأْمُرُ قُرَيْشًا أَنْ تَسْأَلَ مُحَمَّدًا مِثْلَ مَا أُوتِيَ مُوسَى، فَقَالَ اللَّهُ لِمُحَمَّدْ: قُلْ لِقُرَيْشٍ، فَلْيَقُولُوا لِلْيَهُوَدِ {أَوَلَمْ يَكْفُرُوا بِمَا أُوتِيَ مُوسَى مِنْ قَبْلُ} [القصص: 48] "

Report 31p. 529Q 28:48

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "two works of sorcery" [al-Qasas 48] he said: "meaning Moses and Muhammad, peace be upon them both; this is the saying of the Jews."

أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {سِحْرَانِ} [القصص: 48] قَالَ: «يَعْنِي مُوسَى وَمُحَمَّدًا صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمَا، هَذَا قَوْلُ الْيَهُوَدِ»

Report 32p. 530Q 28:48

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "Indeed we are, in both, disbelievers" [al-Qasas 48] "The Jews said: 'We also disbelieve in what Muhammad ﷺ was given.'"

أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {إِنَّا بِكُلٍّ كَافِرُونَ} [القصص: 48] " فَقَالَتِ الْيَهُوَدُ: نَكْفُرُ أَيْضًا بِمَا أُوتِيَ مُحَمَّدٌ عليه السلام "

Report 33p. 530Q 28:51

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "And We have made the word follow one another for them" [al-Qasas 51] meaning: "for Quraysh; He says: We sent admonition upon admonition to them."

أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {وَلَقَدْ وَصَّلْنَا لَهُمُ الْقَوْلَ} [القصص: 51] ، يَعْنِي: " لِقُرَيْشٍ، يَقُولُ: تَابَعْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ الْمَوْعِظَةَ "

Report 34p. 530Q 28:52Q 28:55

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "Those to whom We gave the Scripture before it, they believe in it" [al-Qasas 52] up to His words "Peace be upon you; we do not seek the ignorant" [al-Qasas 55]: "concerning the Muslims among the People of the Book."

أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {الَّذِينَ آتَيْنَاهُمُ الْكِتَابَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِ هُمْ بِهِ يُؤْمِنُونَ} [القصص: 52] إِلَى قَوْلِهِ {سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكُمْ لَا نَبْتَغِي الْجَاهِلِينَ} [القصص: 55] «فِي مُسْلِمِي أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ»

Report 35p. 530Q 28:56

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid: The Messenger of God ﷺ said to Abu Talib: "Say the word of sincerity, that I may plead for you with it on the Day of Resurrection." He said: "O son of my brother, the religion of the elders." So God, Mighty and Majestic, revealed: "Indeed, you do not guide whom you like, but God guides whom He wills" [al-Qasas 56], meaning: "those for whom guidance and misguidance have been decreed."

أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِأَبِي طَالِبٍ: " قُلْ كَلِمَةَ الْإِخْلَاصِ أُجَادِلْ بِهَا عَنْكَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ، قَالَ: يَا ابْنَ أَخِي، مِلَّةُ الْأَشْيَاخِ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عز وجل: {إِنَّكَ لَا تَهْدِي مَنْ أَحْبَبْتَ وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ يَهْدِي مَنْ يَشَاءُ} [القصص: 56] ، يَعْنِي: لِمَنْ قُدِّرَ لَهُ الْهُدَى وَالضَّلَالَةُ "

Report 36p. 530Q 28:61

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid: "then he, on the Day of Resurrection, will be among those brought forward" [al-Qasas 61] meaning: "brought to the Fire."

أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ: {ثُمَّ هُوَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مِنَ الْمُحْضَرِينَ} [القصص: 61] ، يَعْنِي: «بِمَحْضَرِ النَّارِ»

Report 37p. 531Q 28:66

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "But the news will be obscured to them that Day" [al-Qasas 66] meaning: "the arguments"; "so they will not ask one another" [al-Qasas 66] He says: "they will not ask one another about lineages."

أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {فَعَمِيَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ الْأَنْبَاءُ يَوْمَئِذٍ} [القصص: 66] ، يَعْنِي: «الْحُجَجَ» ، {فَهُمْ لَا يَتَسَاءَلُونَ} [القصص: 66] يَقُولُ: «لَا يَتَسَاءَلُونَ بِالْأَنْسَابِ»

Report 38p. 531Q 28:71

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "Tell me, if God were to make the night continuous for you" [al-Qasas 71] meaning: "perpetual, never ending."

أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، ثنا آدَمُ، ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِنْ جَعَلَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمُ اللَّيْلَ سَرْمَدًا} [القصص: 71] ، يَعْنِي: «دَائِمًا لَا يَنْقَطِعُ»

Report 39p. 531Q 28:75

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "And We will extract from every nation a witness" [al-Qasas 75] meaning: "a messenger."

أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {وَنَزَعْنَا مِنْ كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ شَهِيدًا} [القصص: 75] ، يَعْنِي: «رَسُولًا»

Report 40p. 531Q 28:75

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid: "Produce your proof" [al-Qasas 75] that is: "your argument for what you worship."

أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، ثنا آدَمُ، ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ: {هَاتُوا بُرْهَانَكُمْ} [القصص: 75] أَيْ: «حُجَّتَكُمْ بِمَا تَعْبُدُونَ»

Report 41p. 531Q 6:24

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "and what they used to invent will be lost from them" [al-Anam 24]: "what they used to worship and claim."

أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، ثنا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {وَضَلَّ عَنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوا يَفْتَرُونَ} [الأنعام: 24] «مَا كَانُوا يَعْبُدُونَ وَيَقُولُونَ»

Report 42p. 531Q 28:76

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "would burden a band of men" [al-Qasas 76] he said: "The usba is from ten to fifteen"; and "those of strength" [al-Qasas 76]: "fifteen."

أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {لَتَنُوءُ بِالْعُصْبَةِ} [القصص: 76] قَالَ: " الْعُصْبَةُ: مَا بَيْنَ الْعَشَرَةِ إِلَى خَمْسَةَ عَشَرَ "، وَ {أُولِي الْقُوَّةِ} [القصص: 76] «خَمْسَةَ عَشَرَ»

Report 43p. 531Q 28:76

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "Indeed, God does not like the exultant" [al-Qasas 76] meaning: "the boastful, insolent, arrogant who do not thank God for what He has given them."

أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، ثنا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ الْفَرِحِينَ} [القصص: 76] ، يَعْنِي: «الْمُتَبَذِّخِينَ الْأَشِرِينَ الْبَطِرِينَ الَّذِينَ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ فِيمَا أَعْطَاهُمْ»

Report 44p. 532Q 28:77

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "and do not forget your share of this world" [al-Qasas 77] He says: "do not forget to act in it in obedience to Me."

أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {وَلَا تَنْسَ نَصِيبَكَ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا} [القصص: 77] يَقُولُ: «لَا تَنْسَ الْعَمَلَ فِيهَا بِطَاعَتِي»

Report 45p. 532Q 28:78Q 55:41

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid: "and the criminals will not be asked about their sins" [al-Qasas 78] he said: It is like His words: "The criminals will be known by their mark" [al-Rahman 41], meaning: "blue-eyed, black-faced; He says: the angels will not ask about them, for they know them."

أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ: {وَلَا يُسْأَلُ عَنْ ذُنُوبِهِمُ الْمُجْرِمُونَ} [القصص: 78] قَالَ: هُوَ كَقَوْلِهِ: {يُعْرَفُ الْمُجْرِمُونَ بِسِيمَاهُمْ} [الرحمن: 41] ، يَعْنِي: " زُرْقًا سُودَ الْوجُوهِ، يَقُولُ: الْمَلَائِكَةُ لَا تَسْأَلُ عَنْهُمْ قَدْ عَرَفَتْهُمْ "

Report 46p. 532Q 28:85

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "Indeed, He who imposed upon you the Qur'an" [al-Qasas 85] meaning: "gave it to you."

أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {إِنَّ الَّذِي فَرَضَ عَلَيْكَ الْقُرْآنَ} [القصص: 85] ، يَعْنِي: «أَعْطَاكَهُ»

Report 47p. 532

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Hammad ibn Salama related to us, from Ali ibn Zayd ibn Judan, who said: Abd God ibn al-Harith ibn Nawfal related to us, saying: "Qarun used to harm Moses with every kind of harm, and he was his cousin. He said to a prostitute: 'When the people gather around me tomorrow, come and say: Moses solicited me for sex; and you will have such-and-such.' When

أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ جُدْعَانَ، قَالَ: نا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ نَوْفَلٍ، قَالَ: " كَانَ قَارُونُ يُؤْذِي مُوسَى بِكُلِّ أَذًى، وَكَانَ ابْنُ عَمِّهِ، فَقَالَ لِامْرَأَةٍ بَغِيٍّ: إِذَا اجْتَمَعَ النَّاسُ عِنْدِي غَدًا فَتَعَالِي فَقُولِي: إِنَّ مُوسَى رَاوَدَنِي عَنْ نَفْسِي، وَلَكِ كَذَا وَكَذَا، فَلَمَّا كَانَ

Report 48p. 533

the next day came and the people gathered around Qarun, the woman came and said: 'Qarun ordered me to say that Moses solicited me, but Moses did not say that to me.' Moses heard of what he had said while he was in the prayer niche, and prostrated and said: 'My Lord, Qarun has gone as far in harming me as to say such-and-such.' God revealed to him: 'O Moses, I have commanded the earth to obey you, I have commanded the sky to obey you, and I have commanded the seas to obey you.' Moses went to Qarun, who was in a chamber of his overlaid with sheets of gold, and said: 'O Qarun, did you say such-and-such?' [Then:] 'O earth, take them,' and it took them to their ankles. Qarun and those with him said to him: 'O Moses, call upon your Lord for us, and He will save us and we will believe in you.' He said: 'O earth, take them,' and it took them to their knees. They said the same to him. He said: 'O earth, take them,' and it took them to their waists. They said the same. He kept saying that and they kept saying to him: 'O Moses, call upon your Lord for us, and He will save us and we will believe in you,' until it closed over them while they were crying out. God revealed to him: 'How harsh you are, Moses! By My might, had they called upon Me even once, I would have had mercy on them and answered them.'"

الْغَدُ، وَاجْتَمَعَ النَّاسُ عِنْدَ قَارُونَ جَاءَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ، فَقَالَتْ: إِنَّ قَارُونَ أَمَرَنِي أَقُولُ: إِنَّ مُوسَى رَاوَدَنِي عَنْ نَفْسِي، وَإِنَّ مُوسَى لَمْ يَقُلْ لِي ذَلِكَ، فَبَلَغَ مُوسَى قَوْلُهُ، وَهُوَ فِي الْمِحْرَابِ فَسَجَدَ، فَقَالَ: يَا رَبِّ إِنَّ قَارُونَ قَدْ بَلَغَ مِنْ أَذَاهُ أَنْ قَالَ: كَذَا وَكَذَا، فَأَوْحَى اللَّهُ إِلَيْهِ أَنْ يَا مُوسَى، إِنِّي قَدْ أَمَرْتُ الْأَرْضَ أَنْ تُطِيعَكَ، وَقَدْ أَمَرْتُ السَّمَاءَ أَنْ تُطِيعَكَ، وَقَدْ أَمَرْتُ الْبِحَارَ أَنْ تُطِيعَكَ، فَأَتَى مُوسَى قَارُونَ وَهُوَ فِي غَرْفَةٍ لَهُ قَدْ ضَرَبَ عَلَيْهَا صَفَائِحَ الذَّهَبِ، فَقَالَ: يَا قَارُونُ أَقُلْتَ كَذَا وَكَذَا؟ يَا أَرْضُ خُذِيهِمْ، فَأَخَذَتْهُمْ إِلَى أَكْعُبِهِمْ، فَقَالَ لَهُ قَارُونُ وَمَنْ مَعَهُ: يَا مُوسَى ادْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ فَيُنْجِينَا وَنُؤْمِنُ بِكَ، فَقَالَ: يَا أَرْضُ خُذِيهِمْ، فَأَخَذَتْهُمْ إِلَى رُكَبِهِمْ، فَقَالُوا لَهُ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ، فَقَالَ: يَا أَرْضُ خُذِيهِمْ، فَأَخَذَتْهُمْ إِلَى أَنْصَافِهِمْ، فَقَالُوا مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ، فَلَمْ يَزَلْ يَقُولُ ذَلِكَ، وَيَقُولُونَ لَهُ يَا مُوسَى: ادْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ فَيُنْجِينَا، وَنُؤْمِنُ بِكَ حَتَّى تَطَابَقَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَهُمْ يَهْتِفُونَ، فَأَوْحَى اللَّهُ إِلَيْهِ: مَا أَفَظَّكَ يَا مُوسَى، أَمَا وَعِزَّتِي لَوْ دَعَوْنِي دَعْوَةً وَاحِدَةً لَرَحِمْتُهُمْ وَلَأَجَبْتُهُمْ "
